title: Model change that turns rejected fields into verified wrong values, or leaves a scope field out of a rate record
assertion: Gate fails: wrong-but-verified (a scope field left out of a rate record included) counted per field apart from rejected and missed, never above its baseline, zero on faithful-text cases and never above the local reference, nor off its misread records, on the others, on the synthetic set and on permitted examples; a run with a failed or refused call is never recorded; a real provider is never recorded with a recall or precision floor unset or unmet; a set change never lands with a model change; a scope field a proposed rate record leaves out is named to the specialist as not stated
noFileReason: The gate’s counting rule, scored on the MOD-09 set and on permitted examples; no file of its own.
